exposure: use of heated, humidified, high-flow nasal cannula (HHHFNC)
cohort: The study included all extremely preterm infants younger than 28 weeks of gestational age admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of a tertiary hospital from January 1, 2020, to December 31, 2022.
finding: Extremely preterm infants who received HHHFNC had a significantly longer hospital stay (average 99 days) compared to those who did not (average 42.5 days).
